title: Metro map city import config
description: city.config.json: tells `npm run import` how to build public/data/<id>.json for one city. Imports run in order; their lines are merged into one CityData (stations shared by name + distance).

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor autocompletion. Usually "../../scripts/import/city-config.schema.json".

id.description: City id, lowercase kebab-case ASCII (e.g. "hanoi", "ho-chi-minh-city"). Output goes to public/data/<id>.json.

name.description: City name in Latin script, e.g. "Hanoi".

nameLocal.description: City name in the local language / script, e.g. "Hà Nội", "東京".

country.description: Country name shown in the city picker, e.g. "Vietnam".

zoom.description: Initial map zoom (MapLibre), typically 10-11 for a whole city.

timeline.description: Year range of the timeline slider. Default: min..max of all segment years.

bbox.description: Area of interest [minLng, minLat, maxLng, maxLat]. Adapters (OSM) clip / filter to it.

base.description: Existing CityData to extend, relative to the project root, e.g. "public/data/hanoi.json". Its lines and stations are kept; imported lines with the same id replace base lines; imported stations merge into base stations by name + distance.

groups.description: Line groups (operator / network / mode). Lines reference them by id; unknown group ids are created automatically.

sources.description: Sources that lines cite by id (`sources` on lines, import defaults or overrides).

notes.description: Plain-text caveats shown in the info panel.

imports.description: Data sources, run in order: "osm" (OpenStreetMap route relations), "geojson" or "kml" (hand-drawn maps, e.g. geojson.io or Google My Maps exports).

lines.description: Per-line overrides applied after import. Keys match a line id, import key (OSM relation / GeoJSON `line`), code or name (case-insensitive).

stationMergeMeters.description: Same-name stations closer than this become one shared (interchange) station. Default 400.

snapMeters.description: GeoJSON/KML only: a station Point attaches to every drawn line within this distance (unless it names its lines with `line`). Default 150.

simplifyMeters.description: Douglas-Peucker tolerance for segment paths, metres. Default 15.

status.description: operating = revenue service; construction = physically under construction; approved = investment approved / funded; planned = in an official master plan; proposed = studies, concepts, vision.

mode.description: Transit mode: metro, commuter (suburban / regional rail), lrt, monorail, tram, agt (automated guideway), shinkansen (high-speed).

year.description: Year (actual opening year, or target year for non-operating sections).

group.description: A group of lines (operator / network / mode).

parent.description: Id of the parent group (for nesting, e.g. "jr" > "jr-east").

source.description: A citation lines can reference by id.

id.description: Source id that lines cite, e.g. "osm", "qd-1569".

accessed.description: ISO date the source was accessed, e.g. "2026-11-14".

defaults.description: Defaults for every line this import produces; values set in the data win.

group.description: Group id for lines without one.

sources.description: Source ids for lines that cite none.

import.description: One data source. `type` selects the adapter.

importOsm.description: Import route relations from OpenStreetMap (Overpass API; cached in <city>/.cache, use --refresh to re-download).

network.description: Keep relations whose network=* is one of these (exact).

operator.description: Keep relations whose operator=* is one of these (exact).

exclude.description: Drop lines whose key / name / ref / code matches.

groupBy.description: One line per route_master (default) or per route relation.

importFile.description: Import a hand-drawn GeoJSON or KML file. LineStrings are lines (features sharing `line` / `name` are segments of one line), Points are stations.

type.description: "geojson" (.geojson / .json) or "kml" (Google My Maps / Google Earth / QGIS export).

file.description: Input file, relative to the folder holding city.config.json.

label.description: Segment label, e.g. "Phase 1: Nhổn – Cầu Giấy".

lineOverride.description: Override fields of one imported line.

nameLocal.description: Line name in the local language.

opened.description: Year the first section opened / opens.

sources.description: Source ids (added to the imported ones).

segments.description: Patch segments by index; null leaves a segment as is.
